card.statement:
If $\delta\notin P_0$, then

\[
\cG^0 = \bigoplus_{i=1}^m \frak{g}^i,
\]

where each $\frak{g}^i$ is either isomorphic to $\fsl(m,n)$ with $m\neq n$, $\fosp(m,n)$, $D(2,1;\alpha)$ ($a\neq 0,-1$), $G(3)$, $F(4)$, or to $\frak{sl}(1,1)$, and $[\frak{g}^i,\frak{g}^j]=0$ if $i\neq j$.

- If $\delta\in P_0$, then $\cG^0=\cG^1+\cG^2$, with

\[
\cG^1=\bigoplus_{i=1}^m L(\g^i)\oplus \C K,
\]

where each $\frak{g}^i$ is either isomorphic to $\fsl(m,n)$ with $m\neq n$, $\fosp(m,n)$, $D(2,1;\alpha)$ ($a\neq 0,-1$), $G(3)$, $F(4)$, or to $\frak{sl}(1,1)$, $[\frak{g}^i,\frak{g}^j]=0$ if $i\neq j$; and $\cG^2\subseteq \fH$ is such that $\cG^2+(\cG^1\cap \fH)=\fH$. Moreover, $\cG^2$ can be chosen so that $[\cG^1, \cG^2]=0$ if and only if $\frak{g}^i\ncong \frak{sl}(1,1)$, for all $i=1,\dots, m$.
card.label: Theorem 0

paper.title: Highest weight modules for affine Lie superalgebras
paper.abstract: We describe Borel and parabolic subalgebras of affine Lie superalgebras and study the Verma type modules associated to such subalgebras. We give necessary and sufficient conditions under which these modules are simple.
